name: bayl.es-style
description: The shared look of the *.bayl.es sites: color tokens, base styles and components.
author: Jordan Bayles

scripts.build: lightningcss --bundle --targets "chrome 123, firefox 120, safari 17.5" src/eopsin.css -o dist/eopsin.css && node scripts/header.mjs && lightningcss --bundle --minify --browserslist src/eopsin.css -o dist/eopsin.min.css && node scripts/ha-theme.mjs && node scripts/immich-theme.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run check:version && npm run build && git add -N dist home-assistant immich && git diff --exit-code -- dist home-assistant immich
scripts.check:version: node -e "const v='v'+require('./package.json').version, s=require('fs').readFileSync('docs/index.html','utf8'); if(!s.includes('const VERSION = \"'+v+'\"')){console.error('docs/index.html VERSION is not '+v);process.exit(1)}"
